g.title: note
g.text: PK: primary key FK: foreign key UK: single-column unique key
Null: whether a column permits SQL NULL
Orders.OrderID = workbook Row Number. SourceOrderID is retained and is not unique.
MenuComponents describes bundle membership, not item-level order quantities.
Bookings are separately labeled fixtures; no workbook booking association is invented.
Cardinalities describe constraints, not observed row counts.
